why: refreshWidgets ends in a bare catch {} with no log, ignores widgetSave's false return (native catches Throwable and returns false), and phoneSync calls it with .catch(()=>undefined)
readSafetyFile swallows a parse/read error (catch -> file=null) and then deletes the file with no log; init only sets canUndoRestore=false, so Undo silently disappears; rare path (corrupt local file)

On the first open with talk=null but questions read, state becomes ready with talk null and the failedRead note is set only when byPull; the list then shows only questions or 'You have not sent a message yet.'

afterChecks does newExercisesIn(ticked).catch(() => []) and suggestMatches(...).catch(() => []) with no log or message, so a failed check skips the 'new exercises' step and save creates them all as custom; rare (local DB read failing)

showRestCard catches every error and returns false with no log; scheduleRestEnd then wraps the fallback schedule in try { } catch { // ignore }, so a double failure leaves no buzz, no note and no on-screen word

hq_push_next (live def 0053) advances after_token past the batch before sending; push.js only counts 'retry'/'auth' outcomes as failed and never re-queues those tokens, so a passing FCM outage drops those members' pop-ups

joinPage only fetches the asset, rewrites gym name/logo and returns it; no counter, Analytics Engine binding or beacon exists in deploy/panel (grep empty). Only caveat: a zone-level Cloudflare Web Analytics switch cannot be read from code

0089 (live self-join def) uses up the proof once the request is kept (line 70) and checks TRIAL_USED before it (64-66); the page's .catch only says TRY_AGAIN and a resend gets BAD_PROOF -> step 1, then TRIAL_USED; no same-request recognition anywhere. Needs a lost response, so rare

_ai_q_take (live def 0083) skips the members switch for visitors (141) and counts member+visitor answers against one month_credits limit (164-167); 0094 page chat calls it as 'visitor'; the sheet's section title and limitHint speak only of members. Visitors do appear in the usage rows once there are some

The box keeps landlines as typed (mobileOrAsTyped), but the save check runs normalizePhone('91', ...) whose trunkStripped candidate turns 08023456789 into 8023456789 (valid 6-9 start) -> +918023456789, while 011/022 numbers and 'a / b' fail isValidNational and are refused

The plan's trainer is a free-text box (Plans.tsx:397-399) and the only caller of assignTrainer is the member page picker (TrainerParts.tsx:115), so a sale never assigns; partial softening: the trainer's PT class list does match a running pack by typed first/full name (trainerSchedule.ts:296-327), but progress, My members and questions follow the server assignment only

The board (_board_rows, only def 0037) and other app views filter on gym_members.left_at is null, and the only writer of left_at in all migrations is member_leave (0008/0016/0025:670); desk archiving is a crm_records data flag that never touches gym_members

The save toast is the fixed 'Saved. Members see it now.' and the plan builder line is fixed MEMBERS_SEE_IT text; neither screen reads how many members use the app (no such count in either file); the test-gym 0-of-2 figure is from the field-fill source and was not re-counted

The phone field's autosave check is parsePhone, which accepts any 7-15 digits without '+', while the box itself (anyCountryMobileInput) treats a no-'+' number as Indian; so a 7-9 digit Indian number is saved as valid with no error

The bio branch only calls setProfileExtras (a local SQLite UPDATE) and never shareWithMates; the only 'setting' trigger is the gym-sees switch screen, so a new or cleared bio waits for the next workout or the 6-hour start/return send
